policy.ci_run_data: blocked across GitHub MCP tools, generic GitHub fetch URLs, shells, and every other route
policy.environment_scope: only exact allowlisted, repository-scoped GitHub MCP operations can run; every successful result crosses PostToolUse '*'

notes: Hard GitHub tool allowlist is code-owned in .claude/hooks/pre_tool_use.py; this JSON cannot add an execution route.
Every tool not explicitly allowlisted is denied before execution, including newly introduced tool names.
Repository writes require an explicitly named non-main branch; boundary files and tree deletions are denied.
Project files cannot constrain a separate unmanaged Claude installation outside sessions that load these settings and hooks; host-managed policy is required for that separate trust boundary.
enabled is documentary only; hard enforcement lives in code.
All limits are bounded again by hard ceilings in the hooks.
The observation mechanism has no runtime off switch.
